per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The application should follow a consistent component library and conventions to ensure predictable UI behavior.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application shall comply with the corporate standards for user interface creation for internally and externally used applications.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The application should ensure that search results behave consistently regardless of the integration used last time.
The application should ensure that color coding for quick identification is accessible to color-blind users and complies with corporate accessibility rules.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The list of dispute cases that are displayed after a search is performed must be color coded for easy identification of dispute cases based upon the dispute case status.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The application should log supervisor overrides with justification and notify the case owner.
The application should enforce authorization checks server-side to prevent unauthorized access to cases.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes System must prevent users from accessing any dispute cases that do not belong to their cardholder base.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The application should use role-based access control for actions and attribute-based access control for case access.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application shall ensure that only users with the appropriate access level are allowed to initiate dispute requests.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The application should maintain an audit trail that captures who did what, the before-and-after values, and any reason codes.
The application should ensure that correspondence templates are stored consistently and can be retrieved for review.
The application should load essential data first and then stream in secondary details asynchronously to meet the five-second response time target.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The maximum wait time for a user navigating from one screen to another within the Disputes application shall be no more than 5 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The application should have SLAs or known latencies for the Statement, Cardmember, and Merchant services to plan for retries and timeouts.
The application should handle backend failures gracefully by showing stale data banners and preventing inconsistent writes.
The application should implement optimistic locking with conflict resolution to prevent concurrent updates from overwriting each other's changes.
The application should support a peak of 350 concurrent users with no degradation in performance or error rates.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application shall support 350 concurrent users without any degradation of performance in the application.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The application should have clear ownership for load testing and maintenance windows to ensure consistent performance and availability.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application shall support 350 concurrent users without any degradation of performance in the application.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The application should be available around the clock with scheduled maintenance windows clearly defined and communicated.
The application should comply with multi-year retention requirements for audit logs and correspondence.
